tax.text: She calls for the wealthiest Americans and corporations to pay their fair share to reduce income inequality.
tax.quote: Lateefah will push for economic policies that ensure the wealthiest Americans and corporations pay their fair share to reduce income inequality

wages.text: She backs labor law reforms to strengthen collective bargaining and supports a living wage.
wages.quote: Lateefah will continue to fight for the rights of workers by enacting comprehensive labor law reforms to ensure collective bargaining and workplace democracy for all workers

housing.text: She prioritizes building affordable housing and transit-oriented development to address the housing crisis.
housing.quote: With a focus on urgency and innovation, Lateefah is leading efforts to build affordable housing and transit-oriented development.

safety.text: She favors funding mental health, addiction treatment, and recidivism-prevention programs as part of her public safety approach.
safety.quote: provides resources for mental health, addiction treatment, and programs geared towards preventing recidivism

immigration.text: She supports expanding legal pathways to work authorization and citizenship and separating the criminal and immigration systems.
immigration.quote: She will work to create a fair and humane immigration system that would disentangle the criminal system from the immigration system and expand legal pathways to work authorization and citizenship.

guns.text: She backs legislation to close loopholes in federal gun laws and stop the flow of illegal firearms.
guns.quote: Lateefah will champion legislation that closes loopholes in federal gun laws, stops the flow of illegal firearms into the community

abortion.text: Introduced and supported a resolution affirming reproductive freedom and access to reproductive health care.
abortion.quote: This resolution affirms reproductive freedom as a fundamental human right

gender.text: She champions policies that protect transgender rights and access to gender-affirming health care.
gender.quote: She will not only support but champion policies that combat discrimination, protect transgender rights, and ensure access to healthcare and social services for LGBTQ+ people.

health.text: She advocates for a public option and ultimately an affordable single-payer health system, plus expanded Medicare.
health.quote: Lateefah will fight to expand and protect healthcare coverage, advocating for a public option and ultimately working towards an affordable single-payer health system.

energy.text: She calls climate the biggest existential threat and backs a transition to net-zero emissions and the Green New Deal.
energy.quote: Critical to this work is the transition to net-zero emissions and our continued investment into clean energy alternatives.

voting.text: She supports the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act, automatic voter registration, and reducing barriers to voting.
voting.quote: She will support the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act, push for automatic voter registration, and advocate for measures that reduce barriers to voting.

immigration.text: Joyce authored a dedicated title of her MAD Act aimed at removing ICE from streets and sharply restricting interior immigration enforcement.
immigration.quote: A strategy to get ICE off of our streets (urban and suburban areas) immediately is the 8th title of the MAD Act.
